audit_name: C16 Metric Implementation and Mathematical Definition Audit

audit_findings.classes_included: Classes 1..11 (AF, BS, LWA, MCC, OF, POW, RF, WS, Eddy, IWs, HM). Class 0 (BG) is excluded from the phenomena macro-average.
audit_findings.background_exclusion: CONFIRMED_EXCLUDED. In both C16 train_replicate003.py and reference exp07_reference.py, Class 0 (BG) is explicitly excluded via `if c > 0:` before appending to valid_ious.
audit_findings.ignore_index_handling: CONFIRMED_CORRECT. Pixels with target == -100 (due to invalid border padding or excluded classes 3, 9, 14) are filtered out prior to confusion matrix accumulation: `if t != IGNORE_INDEX and 0 <= t < 12 and 0 <= p < 12:`.
audit_findings.validity_masks_applied: CONFIRMED_APPLIED. raw_image > 0 validity mask is applied to zero-out border pixels in the input tensor and set dense target to -100 in target mask.

absent_class_handling.c16_implementation: In train_replicate003.py, `denom[c] = tp + fp + fn`. If `denom[c] > 0`, IoU is calculated and added to valid_ious. If a class had 0 GT and 0 predictions, denom=0 and class is excluded from macro average.
absent_class_handling.reference_implementation: In exp07_reference.py, `if gt[c] > 0` condition is used.
absent_class_handling.reconciliation: Because ALL 11 phenomenon classes are physically present in the 40 DEV ground truth samples (AF=39,385, BS=123,771, LWA=58,567, MCC=853,315, OF=1,709, POW=78,415, RF=9,550, WS=131,037, Eddy=45,322, IWs=579,526, HM=117 pixels), `gt[c] > 0` holds for all 11 classes. Therefore, denominator is exactly 11 in both implementations.
absent_class_handling.numerical_equivalence: CONFIRMED_IDENTICAL. When evaluated on the 40 DEV samples using DataLoader, C16 compute_metrics yields 0.049399 and exp07_reference.py compute_metrics_from_confusion_matrix yields 0.049399.

audit_findings.denominator_calculation: CONFIRMED_EXACT. Macro-average sums valid IoUs and divides by len(valid_ious) = 11.
audit_findings.logit_class_alignment: CONFIRMED_ALIGNED. Argmax over dimension 1 directly produces class indices 0..11 matching DENSE_CLASSES ordering.
audit_findings.label_remapping: CONFIRMED_EXACT. remap_source_mask_to_dense converts 15-class source labels to canonical 12 dense indices once during __getitem__.
audit_findings.class_11_hm_inclusion: CONFIRMED_INCLUDED. Class 11 (HM) is included as the 11th phenomenon class. Due to 0 true positive predictions, its IoU is 0.0, contributing 0 to numerator and +1 to denominator.
audit_findings.canonical_class_order: Canonical 12-class order [BG, AF, BS, LWA, MCC, OF, POW, RF, WS, Eddy, IWs, HM] matches across C8, C10, C15, and C16.

comparative_audit_vs_c8_c10.c8_c10_ops01_metric_implementation: Used the exact same 12-class confusion matrix formula and macro-averaging over phenomena classes 1..11.
comparative_audit_vs_c8_c10.performance_difference_explanation: The drop from ~0.4072 in C8 to 0.0494 in C16 is NOT an artifact of metric calculation. It reflects true out-of-distribution generalization failure when moving from random slice splitting (OPS-01) to cluster-level disjoint parent datatake partitioning (OPS-02), exacerbated by extreme class sparsity on DEV.
